opening.argument: The presentation identifies an Avalanche Visa-powered crypto payment solution designed for real-world use, placing the subject in the context of ordinary transactions rather than an extraordinary promised outcome. It explains that users can spend AVAX, USDC, USDT, and RAFT AVAX anywhere Visa is accepted, while the speaker frames the recommendation as personal research. The invitation to visit is ordinary audience engagement: although signups are open, following that prompt is not presented as a condition for using the card or participating in a financial offer.

citations.quote: Avalanche has just launched that Avalanche card a Visa-powered crypto payment solution designed for real world use
it allows users to spend AVAX USDC USDT and RAFT AVAX anywhere Visa is accepted without off ramps or bank restrictions
Signups are open so that it does something interesting I recommend you head over.
